title: Topo vs 3slot offline optimization and representation diagnostics audit
scope: Read-only analysis of saved runs. No training, SUMO, evaluation, or production source changes.
primary_question: Whether the Topo vs Topo+3slot behavior change is supported by saved optimization/representation evidence, including gate activity, route/topology utilization, slot gradients and allocation.

definitions_and_sampling.optimization_rows: 100 callback rows per completed retry01 run. Row timing is latest_available_logger_values_at_callback, not necessarily same-update measurements. Includes an initial/warm-up section; reported segment starts at 5k raw steps.
definitions_and_sampling.optimizer_metrics: Actor/critic losses and alpha are logger snapshots. Q and mean absolute TD fields are sparse sampled critic minibatches, not replay-wide calibration.
definitions_and_sampling.train_activation: 1609 rows per completed retry01 run; diagnostic_source_code and diagnostic_sample_source_code are 1, which source maps to train_replay; sample every 256 extractor forwards. Batch=32 for 1478 Topo and 1487 3slot activation rows; batch=1 for 131 and 122. `diagnostic_sample_grad_enabled` true for 1136 and 1111 respectively. Sample age is 0–4 forwards at collection. These are replay-batch forward snapshots, not current rollout episode state.
definitions_and_sampling.critic_td_gradient: 96 rows per run; first sampled at update 1 and then periodic critic updates. The SAC code collects after critic_loss.backward and before clipping; actor gradients are not included. The custom scalar L2 ratio is group gradient L2 / parameter L2.
definitions_and_sampling.eval_activation: 100-episode deterministic final_model evaluations; 8481 Topo / 8649 3slot prediction rows, one per policy prediction, batch size 1. Cross-batch variance and sample-energy correlations are invalid at batch 1.
definitions_and_sampling.episode_conditioning: Evaluation representation rows were averaged within episode, then group median/mean across episodes. This avoids longer timeout episodes dominating, but does not match state/traffic risk distributions.
definitions_and_sampling.not_logged: No actor parameter-gradient norm, direct policy entropy/log_std, post-LayerNorm delta norm, frozen identical-input representation/Q comparison, nor replay-wide Q calibration.

source_fidelity.interpretation: The completed retry01 topology/policy/SAC/diagnostic implementation files match the captured hashes. The two training entrypoints and sumo_env.py differ from current live files; old run outcomes must be interpreted using its manifests and captured source hashes, not current terminal/environment code. The older d0929 route-only run has no equivalent source_snapshot.json and its diagnostics manifest source_script is train_intersection_yield_v2.py while its evaluation manifest identifies the D1 entrypoint; treat its reported configuration/outcome as historical context, not a byte-frozen implementation comparison.

source_locations.fact: Source code 1 denotes train_replay; parameter groups define topology_core, topology_fusion_goal, topology_vehicle_relations, slot projections and route.
Critic TD gradient telemetry is collected after critic backward and before clipping; actor backward follows; sampled activation snapshots are serialized only when sample id changes.
Gradient parameter coverage and L2 metrics read existing gradients; gradient_to_parameter_l2 is group gradient norm divided by group parameter norm.
Route-heading compatibility is a hard mask and top-K selection; nearest global lane is fallback only if no compatible lane.

Same-lane and conflict/merge lane-distribution scores are multiplied by topology_residual_scale and appended as vehicle graph edge features; diagnostics expose pre-gate pair scores and post-gate edge-feature means.
Topology context is added through the topology gate before topology LayerNorm; goal uses Delta-LN `r + LN(r + gate*t) - LN(r)`. Diagnostics expose scalar gates but not post-LN residual norms.
Defines relation score, route-mass/fallback and edge-feature diagnostic semantics.

code_semantics.gate_and_layernorm: Topology and goal gate values are learned scalar parameters. Topology norm can change direction of a small residual; no post-LN delta telemetry exists, so gate magnitude is not equal to final contribution. At goal gate 0, the Delta-LN formula exactly returns route_base.

evidence_assessment.dead_slots: Not supported. Topo configuration disables the structured projections and keeps the MLP head active; slot gradient coverage zero is expected inactive-path behavior. In 3slot, all three projection groups have 100% critic TD gradient coverage in all 96 samples.
evidence_assessment.gradient_starvation: No dead-gradient evidence for Topo core, goal fusion or relation modules: each is 100% covered across the 96 TD-gradient samples. Later gradient-to-parameter medians are concentrated in goal fusion relative to topology_core, but this is an observation, not proof of bad conditioning; gradients are critic-only and modules differ in scale/role.
evidence_assessment.slot_redundancy: Not established. Train batch32 scalar energy correlations are logged for 3slot but correlate per-sample slot energies, not slot vectors; eval batch1 correlations are invalid. Slot energy shares drift late toward social/route (.411/.452) while ego falls to .137; outputs remain nonzero and receive gradients. No cosine/CKA/information-content/equal-input probe exists.
evidence_assessment.topology_use: Topology relation branch is computationally active: positive pre-gate pair scores, nonzero gates, and full TD-gradient coverage. Route-compatible mass=1 coincides with zero fallback and is mainly enforced by hard masking; it is not evidence the policy chose a route-correct behavior. Late scaled relation edge features are small (~2e-4 median), but state and goal residual effect after LayerNorm is unmeasured.
evidence_assessment.optimization: 3slot does not show a uniformly worse late critic fit: last-10k median critic loss ~5.90 vs Topo ~6.61; sparse mean abs TD ~1.02 vs ~1.49; alpha ~.0212 vs ~.0204. These sampled metrics are not risk-calibrated and cannot establish the 3slot policy is safer; its collision fraction is higher.
evidence_assessment.behavior_context_from_parallel_run_audit: The parent reports all 22 Topo timeout episodes end at wrong-exit lane -E1_0; requested target speed remains about 5.02 m/s, ego starts on lane 2 and only lane 2 connects -E1 to -E0, while lane-change requests were 16 right / 6 keep. This supports a wrong-lane route deadlock as a proximal timeout mechanism. It does not show the attention/gate caused the lane action.
evidence_assessment.causal_limit: One completed training seed per architecture and policy-dependent state/replay distributions. No architecture-only causal attribution or identical-state intervention is possible from these logs. The incomplete prior run is not an evaluation replication.
